'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Brandon Schele LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Schele]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
